resolution: Cause: the area land animation (a/1/4/0, AreaData field 3) binds to land-model materials by index; compose wrote materials in kit order, so paths/cliffs/flowers got the water/pond scrolls. Fix: compose reserves the animation's material slots first (kit.area_animation_materials); lint rule land-anim-order catches it (negative control on the old models: 3 errors). Not a seam metric gap: it is model-structure, now gated by lint. Needs the user's in-game confirmation.
